criteria.requirement: Add cssselect.editable.EditableStateTranslator supporting :read-write/:read-only as exact complements in the selected tree scope. Text-like input/textarea require no readonly/disabled and use the inherited static fieldset-disabled policy; exclude hidden/range/color/button/submit/reset/image/checkbox/radio/file inputs. Form controls never become editable merely from contenteditable ancestors. Other elements inherit the nearest valid contenteditable empty/true/plaintext-only/false declaration case-insensitively; invalid values inherit, false blocks. Support XHTML namespaced declarations, default read-only, preserve GenericTranslator rejection and document snapshot limitations (no scripts/designMode or improved fieldset approximation).
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
